record.reason: JITterFlip studies a Rowhammer fault attack on the JIT serving control plane. It demonstrates corrupt-output and correct-output latency-amplification attacks (up to 124.97x) against inference execution; its objective is to expose and characterize a vulnerability, not to improve inference efficiency or serving performance. The latency result is an attack impact, not an optimization gain.
record.title: JITterFlip: Uncovering Fault Attack Surfaces in JIT-Compiled LLM Serving
